title: Deal path
lead: The client sees the same steps, except the hidden ones. Record each step when it happens.
preview: Nothing recorded yet. These steps are created from the template when the terms are agreed, or with your first action here.

complete.title: Complete the deal
complete.lead: Every step is done or not needed. Confirm the deed or lease date to close the deal as completed.
complete.reviewed: I checked every step on this path and the date above.
complete.boundary: Completing closes the deal with a recorded outcome the client sees and marks the home as sold or let, so it is no longer offered. It does not certify a legal transfer.

blocked.terms_not_agreed: The terms are not agreed yet.
blocked.final_step_open: The last step must be done, not marked as not needed.
blocked.duty_open: The brokerage contract and the identity checks must be done, not marked as not needed.

passed: Passed without a record in the app

brokerage.away: Signed online or away from your office?
brokerage.earlyStart: Did the client ask in writing for your work to start within the withdrawal period?
brokerage.signedAway: Signed online or away from the office
brokerage.earlyStartYes: Client asked in writing to start early
brokerage.earlyStartNo: Client did not ask to start early
brokerage.earlyStartHint: Only when it was signed online or away from your office.

waitsForIdentity: Record the identity checks before this step.
sharedWith: These steps are recorded once for both sides, on the other side's deal
